title: High-pressure boilers.
officialText:
Inspections required by section 28-303.2 of this code‡ of a high-pressure boiler
must be performed, in accordance with the rules of the department, on behalf of the owner, by boiler inspectors in the
employ of a duly authorized insurance company who are qualified in accordance with section 204 of the New York
state labor law.
